messages.author: c2959b3cda9ef153
messages.subject: Two Gvis plots in two tabs ot working
parts:
Hello,

I am trying to plot two different Gvis in 2 tabs but it is not working. However, it works perfectly with just one. Can you help me? 

Below the ui.R code used:

library(shiny)

shinyUI(pageWithSidebar(
  # Application title
  headerPanel("Dashboard"),
  
  sidebarPanel( 
                numericInput("min", "Mínimo",1,1,30),
                numericInput("max", "Máximo",30,1,30),
                checkboxGroupInput("cty","Selecciona el/los países",c(
                  "Brasil"="BR",
                  "Argentina"="AR",
                  "Méjico"="MX",
                  "Chile" = "CL")),
                submitButton(text="Run")),
  
  mainPanel(
    h4("Graphics"),
    tabsetPanel(
     #tabPanel("MotionChart",htmlOutput("motionchart")),
     tabPanel("Map Chart",htmlOutput("mapchart"))
    )
)
  ))

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Two Gvis plots in two tabs ot working
parts:
We are working on a resolution for this. In the meantime, can you see if adding these two lines in your shinyServer function helps?

outputOptions(output, "motionchart", suspendWhenHidden = FALSE)
outputOptions(output, "mapchart", suspendWhenHidden = FALSE)

messages.subject: Re: Two Gvis plots in two tabs ot working
parts:
I'm really sorry, nothing yet. It keeps getting preempted by other work.

If you really need something right now you might be able to make sense out of this, which was a prototype for the approach that I'll need to bring googleVis in line with.

https://github.com/jcheng5/googleCharts

To install:

install.packages("devtools")  # if necessary
devtools::install_github("googleCharts", "jcheng5")

Then see the help topics for ?googleChart and ?googleChartsInit, and see the example here:
https://github.com/jcheng5/googleCharts/tree/master/inst/examples/test
